info.name: ReferralPro API
info.description:
Full API surface for ReferralPro - a multi-tenant referral marketing platform. Covers the original direct-referral flow (API-key integration endpoints) plus the ambassador/Luup integration layered on top: JWT dashboard auth, campaign lifecycle, ambassador onboarding and self-service portal, company outbound API integration, inbound webhooks, and ambassador revenue/reward administration.

Suggested run order for a full happy-path walkthrough: Auth > Register Company, Auth > Verify Email, Auth > Login (Company Admin), Campaign Admin > Create/Publish, Ambassador Application (Public) > Apply, Ambassador Application Admin > Approve, Auth > Accept Invitation, Auth > Login (Ambassador), Referral Redirect (Public) > Click Referral Link, Referral Leads (Public) > Submit Lead, Company Integration Admin > Update Config / Generate Webhook Secret, Webhook (Public) > Receive Service Status, Revenue Admin > List/Approve/Mark Paid Rewards.

Most requests that create or return an id/token include a small test script that saves it into a collection variable, so the requests above can be run top-to-bottom without manually copying values.

item.name: Auth
item.description: JWT dashboard/ambassador login plus the public one-time-token flows (email verification, invitation acceptance) that activate accounts created elsewhere in this collection.

request.description: Dashboard/ambassador login - same endpoint for both roles, the returned `role` claim determines what the token can do. Saves `company_admin_token`/`company_id` on success.
Log in as an ambassador (after accepting their invitation). Saves `ambassador_token` on success.
Roles: PLATFORM_ADMIN, COMPANY_ADMIN, AMBASSADOR. Swap the Authorization header to `Bearer {{ambassador_token}}` to check as an ambassador.

Public, unauthenticated. Activates the COMPANY_ADMIN account created by Company > Register Company (the account starts PENDING and cannot log in until verified). `email_verification_token` is saved automatically by that request's test script.

exec: // Works for both a directly-admin-created ambassador and an approved application -

request.description: Public, unauthenticated. Single-use, expiring token. Sets the invited user's password and activates the account - if the invitation belongs to an ambassador application with a `campaignCode`, this also auto-assigns the ambassador to that campaign and provisions their referral link (Phase 4).
Dev/debug utility - returns the BCrypt hash of a password (e.g. for seeding a dashboard_users row by hand). Public, no real-world security relevance.

request.description: Public, unauthenticated. Creates the Company (status ACTIVE) and its first COMPANY_ADMIN DashboardUser (status PENDING - see Auth > Verify Email), issues a hashed/rotatable API key for the legacy direct-integration endpoints, and seeds a NOT_CONFIGURED CompanyIntegration row. Required: companyName, companyEmail, companyWebsite, industry, country, adminFullName, adminWorkEmail, adminPhone, password, adminRole (a UserRole name, e.g. COMPANY_ADMIN), companySize, preferredCurrency, acceptedTerms. The raw API key and email-verification token are only ever shown in this response.

item.name: Company Admin - API Keys
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated management of the company's own API keys (the hashed, rotatable CompanyApiKey lifecycle - Register Company issues the first one automatically).

request.description: Never returns the raw secret - only a short preview (last 4 characters).
Revokes all currently active keys and issues a new one. The raw secret is shown once, in this response only - saved to `api_key`.
`api_key_record_id` is the numeric row id from List API Keys (not the key string itself).

item.name: Campaign Admin
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated campaign CRUD and lifecycle (DRAFT -> SCHEDULED/ACTIVE -> PAUSED -> ACTIVE -> CLOSED/EXPIRED -> ARCHIVED). Path always carries {{company_id}} but the server ignores it in favor of the authenticated principal's own company (CampaignController#resolveCompanyId) - cross-tenant path-id tampering is rejected.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Summer Referral Campaign",
  "description": "Get $25 for every friend you refer",
  "landingPageUrl": "https://acmerentals.example/summer-promo",
  "startDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00",
  "endDate": "2026-12-31T23:59:59",
  "ambassadorEnrollmentStart": "2026-01-01T00:00:00",
  "ambassadorEnrollmentEnd": "2026-11-30T23:59:59",
  "rewardType": "CREDIT",
  "referrerRewardValue": 25.00,
  "refereeRewardValue": 10.00,
  "conversionEventName": "booking_completed"
}

request.description: Starts in DRAFT. rewardType is one of DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE, CREDIT, POINTS. The ambassador-enrollment window is separate from the customer-referral window (start_date/end_date) - use dates that safely bracket "now" for a working demo. Saves `campaign_id`/`campaign_code`.

Partial update - every field optional, only non-null values applied. rewardType/referrerRewardValue/refereeRewardValue/conversionEventName/startDate are locked once the campaign leaves DRAFT (rejected with 400 otherwise), so a live campaign's already-calculated rewards can't be rewritten out from under it.
DRAFT -> SCHEDULED (start date in the future) or ACTIVE (start date already passed).
ACTIVE -> PAUSED. Also disables any ACTIVE ambassador referral links for this campaign.
PAUSED -> ACTIVE (rejected if the referral window already passed). Re-enables the referral links this same campaign's Pause disabled.
SCHEDULED/ACTIVE/PAUSED -> CLOSED (admin-initiated, permanent, distinct from the worker-driven EXPIRED transition).
EXPIRED/CLOSED -> ARCHIVED.

item.name: Public Campaign
item.description: Unauthenticated - a prospective ambassador opening a published campaign's join link has no account yet.

request.description: Resolves a campaign_code to company/campaign display info + whether enrollment is currently open + a human-readable reason if not. A DRAFT campaign's code is treated as not-found (not yet discoverable). Used by the /join/{campaignCode} landing page before showing the application form.

item.name: Ambassador Admin
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated direct ambassador provisioning (the alternative to the public self-service Ambassador Application flow below).

request.description: Provisions a DashboardUser (PENDING/INVITED) + AmbassadorProfile and issues a one-time invitation token (see Auth > Accept Invitation) - no temporary password is emailed. Company-wide only; use the Ambassador Application flow instead for a campaign-scoped join-link signup.
Issues a fresh invitation token for an ambassador who never completed onboarding.

item.name: Campaign Assignment Admin
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated: assign/unassign ACTIVE ambassadors to campaigns (each assignment provisions a personal referral link). Not needed for ambassadors who joined through a campaign's join link - that flow auto-assigns on invitation acceptance (Phase 4).

request.description: Precondition: each ambassador must already be ACTIVE (a brand-new INVITED account can't be bulk-assigned this way; see Auth > Accept Invitation's campaign-scoped auto-assign instead).
Disables that ambassador's referral link for this campaign specifically - a later campaign-wide Resume won't wrongly re-enable it.

item.name: Ambassador Application (Public)
item.description: Unauthenticated self-service "apply to become an ambassador" flow - the public counterpart to Ambassador Admin > Create Ambassador.

query.description: Optional - omit for a company-wide application not tied to one campaign's join link

request.description: When campaignCode is present, the campaign must belong to companyId, not be DRAFT, and have enrollment currently open, or the submission is rejected outright. Saves `application_id`.

item.name: Ambassador Application Admin
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated review of applications submitted through the public Apply endpoint.

request.description: Provisions the DashboardUser/AmbassadorProfile (INVITED) and issues an invitation token. If the application had a campaignCode, campaign assignment + referral link only happen once the invitation is accepted (Auth > Accept Invitation), not here. Saves `ambassador_id`/`invitation_token`.

item.name: Ambassador Portal (Self-Service)
item.description: AMBASSADOR JWT-authenticated self-service portal - dashboard, assigned campaigns, referral links, referral history, analytics, earnings, and profile. Every endpoint resolves the caller's own ambassador profile server-side; no ambassador id is ever taken from the client.

request.description: Saves the first link's `referral_link_token` (the public token used by Referral Redirect (Public) and Referral Leads (Public)).
status is a ReferralStatus: ACTIVE, LINK_OPENED, REGISTERED, BOOKING_STARTED, BOOKING_CONFIRMED, RENTAL_STARTED, COMPLETED, CONVERTED, REJECTED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED.
Defaults to the trailing 30 days if fromDate/toDate are omitted.
Phase 8: totals for PAID/APPROVED/PENDING+ELIGIBLE/REJECTED+REVERSED rewards, calculated from ambassador-attributed referrals that reached a qualifying status.

item.name: Referral (Direct API-Key Flow)
item.description: Legacy direct-referral integration surface, authenticated with `Authorization: ApiKey {{api_key}}` (ROLE_COMPANY, not a dashboard JWT). Pre-dates the ambassador model; still supported side-by-side.

request.description: Generates a unique referral link for a direct (non-ambassador) customer to share with friends. Saves `referral_code`.

item.name: Referral Redirect (Public)
item.description: Unauthenticated - records the click and redirects. Accepts both ambassador referral-link public tokens and legacy referral codes.

request.description: 302 redirect to the campaign's landing page with `?ref=...`. Sets the `rp_attr_session` attribution cookie Postman will carry into the next request in this collection (enable cookie jar / interceptor). Use {{referral_link_token}} for an ambassador link or {{referral_code}} for the legacy direct flow.

item.name: Referral Leads (Public)
item.description: Unauthenticated - turns an ambassador referral-link click into a Referral once the visitor identifies themselves.

request.description: Idempotent within the same browsing session (rp_attr_session cookie from Referral Redirect > Click Referral Link). Creates the Referral in REGISTERED status and publishes the referral.lead_registered outbox event that drives the Company Integration outbound delivery pipeline.

Prerequisite chain: Company > Register Company, Campaign Admin > Create Campaign + Publish Campaign (must reach ACTIVE - see Campaign.isActive()), Referral (Direct API-Key Flow) > Generate Referral Link (saves `referral_code`). Legacy direct-referral flow only - rejects ambassador-driven referrals (a Referral with no PlatformUser referrer, 400). `eventName` must exactly match the campaign's `conversionEventName` (400 otherwise). Rejects self-referral (`externalUserId`/`email` matching the referrer) and duplicate conversions for the same referral+referee (400, unique constraint `uk_conversions_referral_referee`). On success, records the conversion (`status` COMPLETED then REWARDED) and issues coupon-code rewards to both referrer and referee (`reward.Reward`, distinct from the ambassador-attribution `AmbassadorReward` model under Revenue Admin). Saves `conversion_id`; use Reward (Direct API-Key Flow) > Get Rewards by User with `{{referee_external_user_id}}` or `{{external_user_id}}` (referrer) to see the issued rewards.

item.name: Dashboard (Company Analytics)
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated cross-entity analytics (native SQL under the hood, per this repo's convention) for the direct-referral flow's Campaign/Conversion/Reward model.

item.name: Company Integration Admin
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated: the company's own outgoing Create-User API config (Phase 6) and inbound webhook config/monitoring (Phase 7). Exactly one CompanyIntegration row per company, so no {companyId} path variable.

request.description: Never returns raw credential values - only hasCredentials/hasWebhookSigningSecret booleans. Saves `webhook_public_id`.

authType is one of NONE, API_KEY, BEARER_TOKEN, BASIC - supply only the matching credential fields (apiKeyHeaderName/apiKeyValue, bearerToken, or basicUsername/basicPassword); omitting all credential fields for the current auth type keeps the existing stored ones. statusMappingJson maps a company status string to a ReferralStatus name (applied by webhook processing). rewardMappingJson (Phase 8) optionally overrides which mapped ReferralStatus is QUALIFYING/REVERSING/IGNORE for revenue/reward purposes - defaults to COMPLETED/CONVERTED=QUALIFYING, CANCELLED/REJECTED=REVERSING if omitted.
Best-effort reachability+auth probe - success is any HTTP response other than 401/403 (no known health-check contract for an arbitrary target API).
Queued outgoing submissions are paused, not cancelled - they resume automatically if re-enabled.
status is one of PENDING, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, RETRY_SCHEDULED, PERMANENTLY_FAILED, CANCELLED.
Full per-attempt history, including the failure category/backoff timing of each retry.
The raw value is shown once, in this response only - saved to `webhook_secret` for use by the Webhook (Public) request's pre-request signing script.
status is one of RECEIVED, PROCESSING, PROCESSED, IGNORED, RETRY_SCHEDULED, MANUAL_REVIEW.
Pretty-printed raw payload plus the match/status-mapping outcome and any failure reason.

item.name: Webhook (Public)
item.description: Public, unauthenticated by API key/JWT - authenticated instead via HMAC-SHA256 signature (X-Luup-Signature/X-Luup-Timestamp headers). The company's own systems call this to report service-status changes for a referral.

exec: // Signs the request body exactly as WebhookSignatureVerifier expects:
// Requires {{webhook_secret}} (Company Integration Admin > Generate/Rotate Webhook Secret).

request.description: `status` is matched against the company's configured statusMappingJson (see Company Integration Admin > Update Config) to resolve a ReferralStatus; `serviceReference`/`companyUserReference` are matched against a prior outgoing ApiSubmission's stored references to resolve the target Referral. `eventId` is the redelivery-dedup key - resending the identical body/eventId is safely idempotent. `revenueAmount`/`currency` feed Phase 8's RevenueEvent/AmbassadorReward calculation when the mapped status is QUALIFYING/REVERSING. The pre-request script signs the body automatically; just make sure `webhook_secret`/`webhook_public_id` are populated first.

item.name: Revenue Admin
item.description: COMPANY_ADMIN JWT-authenticated (Phase 8): ambassador-attribution revenue/reward monitoring and the manual ELIGIBLE -> APPROVED -> PAID / REJECTED payout lifecycle. A reward is created automatically when an ambassador-driven referral reaches a qualifying status via an inbound webhook - there is no manual "create reward" endpoint.

request.description: status is one of PENDING, ELIGIBLE, APPROVED, PAID, REJECTED, REVERSED.

Only an ELIGIBLE reward can be approved. A reward may instead be stuck PENDING with holdReason=CURRENCY_MISMATCH if the webhook's currency didn't match the company's preferredCurrency - resolve that manually (approve or reject) rather than expecting it to auto-promote.

Only an APPROVED reward can be marked paid. Manual payout tracking only - no payment gateway integration. Once PAID, a reward is never auto-reversed even if the underlying referral is later cancelled (the RevenueEvent still flips to REVERSED for reporting).
Allowed from any pre-PAID status.
Qualifying/reversed event counts, revenue totals by currency (excludes currency-mismatched rows from the sum rather than blending them), reward totals by status, and an ambassador leaderboard.
